text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is finally the day of the Arima Kinen. 
A massive crowd has gathered to witness 
the clash between Narita Brian and Hishi 
Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian reflects on the past. The 
days she spent walking alongside her 
Trainer had quenched her thirst, if only a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The year's final grand stage, the Arima 
Kinen, is finally getting underway—!
